verdicts.decision_note: The client requests a persistent mobile pricing-table layout that displays all pricing information without horizontal scrolling.
The agency recommends horizontal scrolling instead of the client's requested no-scroll layout and explicitly requests a client decision.
The client selects the existing horizontal-scrolling mobile pricing layout; overwriting the same layout key leaves no obsolete attribute requiring removal.
The client's decision to retain the current pricing approach resolves the pending layout choice and returns the Requirement from clarification to active status.
First concrete verification: during site review, the client reports that the current mobile pricing approach works well and approves retaining it.
